correctness.rationale: Every ideal is uniquely (A,B) with B subset E(A); its rowmotion recurrence follows directly from minimal complement elements. An at-most-three-step argument proves each orbit meets an all-vertices-selected state. Explicit symbolic orbit tables classify such states via graph isolates/universal vertices into exact lengths 2,3,5,6,8. Inclusion-exclusion counts and universal-state multiplicities prove all cycle formulas; explicit examples force exact permutation orders. Direct full finite enumeration for n=3..6 using two separately implemented methods agreed. Larger-n samples are not used as proof.

value.rationale: The incidence poset of K_n is a canonical, rapidly growing rank-two Boolean truncation. Uniform period bound eight, the surprising constant order 120 for all n>=4, and complete closed-form orbit counts supply a structural infinite-family dynamical classification, not a textbook one-step deduction or arbitrary isolated finite computation.
